subject: Learning Methods
title: Why Forgetting Is Useful
description: A short lesson to help you apply Why Forgetting Is Useful.

hook.text: A man named Solomon Shereshevsky remembered everything. His life was a nightmare of cluttered details.

buildup.text: He could recall conversations word for word from decades ago but could not grasp abstract concepts.

discovery.text: Forgetting is an adaptive filter. It clears irrelevant details so your brain can see patterns and generalize.

twist.text: Perfect memory would be disabling, not empowering. You need to forget yesterday's parking spot to find today's.

climax.text: Effective learning is not about remembering everything. It is about remembering what matters.

punchline.text: Forgetting is a feature, not a bug.

quiz.question: Why is forgetting considered adaptive?
options: It frees up physical space in the brain
It clears irrelevant details so the brain can generalize
It prevents information overload in social situations
